scope_common_settings: Method welch, Window hann, OverlapPercent 0 (50 for welch1024 captures), FrequencyResolutionMethod window-length, WindowLength = N (= 8192, one call = one periodogram; 1024 for welch1024), FFTLengthSource auto, AveragingMethod running, SpectralAverages 1 (15 for welch1024), ReferenceLoad 1, FrequencySpan full, FrequencyOffset 0, PlotNormalTrace only
config_log_common: only PhaseNoise/Enabled failed in every capture (property does not exist in R2025a) and SidelobeAttenuation warned 'not applicable' for hann; every measurement property set ok (also the out-of-range bands)

spectrum_model.nfft: max(1024, WindowLength) (FFTLengthSource auto); scope_state.FFTLength/RBW are inactive stored values
spectrum_model.rbw: ENBW = fs*sum(w^2)/sum(w)^2 = 1.5*fs/L for the periodic Hann (1.8310546875 Hz for L 8192, fs 1e4)
spectrum_model.two_sided_grid: MATLAB centered for even NFFT: f_k = k*fs/NFFT, k = -NFFT/2+1 .. NFFT/2 (Nyquist at +fs/2, -fs/2 absent)
spectrum_model.one_sided_grid: k = 0..NFFT/2 (Nyquist included), interior bins doubled, DC/Nyquist not
spectrum_model.measurement_input: PSD = displayed power / RBW (power mode) or the displayed value itself (power-density mode) = dsv_spectrum.welch(...)['psd'] in both modes
spectrum_model.display_parity: fresh displays reproduced to <= 7.8e-11 dB (two-sided, 8192 bins) / 5.3e-11 dB (one-sided, 4097 bins)

rules.rule: same PSD and exact piecewise-constant integration as O1/O2 over main [CF-Span/2, CF+Span/2] (or [Start, Stop]) and lower_k/upper_k = [c -/+ off_k -/+ AdjBW/2] with c = CF or (Start+Stop)/2
rules.proof: 15 FilterShape=none captures: channel power <= 5.3e-14 dB, lower <= 1.3e-13 dB, upper <= 6.6e-8 dB (acpr_cplx_2s_startstop_m500_1500_none proves c = (Start+Stop)/2)

rules.rule: ACPRLower/Upper = 10log10(P_adj/P_main), plain ratio, NO Span/AdjBW normalisation
rules.proof: acpr_cplx_2s_default_none (bwnorm 3.01 dB off), acpr_cplx_2s_three_pairs_none (1.76 dB off)

rules.rule: ChannelPower = 10log10(P_main)+30 dBm in power and power-density mode; ACPR unchanged in power-density mode
a band not inside [f_first, f_last] gives NaN for that band only (no error, no clipping); other bands and channel power unaffected
rules.proof: acpr_cplx_2s_beyond_range (upper2 [4300 5300] NaN), acpr_real_1s_2k_none (lower2 [-1000 0] NaN on one-sided display; -39.6623011742 dBc on the two-sided display acpr_real_2s_2k_none)

rules.rule: FilterShape rrc, FilterCoeff beta: PSD weight W(f) = |H_RRC|^2 = raised-cosine response with symbol rate Rs = Span (main channel span): W=1 for |f-fc| <= (1-beta)Span/2; 0.5(1+cos(pi/(beta*Span)(|f-fc|-(1-beta)Span/2))) up to (1+beta)Span/2; 0 beyond. beta=0 == none
FilterShape gaussian, FilterCoeff BT: W(f) = exp(-ln2*((f-fc)/(BT*Span))^2) (GMSK Gaussian |H|^2, B = BT*Span, T = 1/Span)

the same main-Span-scaled filter is centred on each adjacent band (not scaled by AdjacentBW); W evaluated at bin centres; integration over the band [f1,f2] only (rule A1), not over the filter support; unit gain at centre (no energy normalisation); ratios/channel power as A2/A3 on the filtered powers

rejected_rules.rule: bandpower outward bins / inner bins / trapezoid
integration over the whole filter support
